# astarte_core v1.3.0 - Table of Contents

## Modules

- [Astarte.Core.CQLUtils](https://astarte-core.hexdocs.pm/Astarte.Core.CQLUtils.md): This module contains a set of functions that should be used to map Astarte types and concepts to C*

- [Astarte.Core.Device](https://astarte-core.hexdocs.pm/Astarte.Core.Device.md): Utility functions to deal with Astarte devices

- [Astarte.Core.Device.Capabilities](https://astarte-core.hexdocs.pm/Astarte.Core.Device.Capabilities.md)
- [Astarte.Core.Group](https://astarte-core.hexdocs.pm/Astarte.Core.Group.md): Functions that deal with Astarte groups

- [Astarte.Core.Interface](https://astarte-core.hexdocs.pm/Astarte.Core.Interface.md)
- [Astarte.Core.Interface.Aggregation](https://astarte-core.hexdocs.pm/Astarte.Core.Interface.Aggregation.md)

- [Astarte.Core.Interface.Type](https://astarte-core.hexdocs.pm/Astarte.Core.Interface.Type.md)
- [Astarte.Core.InterfaceDescriptor](https://astarte-core.hexdocs.pm/Astarte.Core.InterfaceDescriptor.md)
- [Astarte.Core.Mapping](https://astarte-core.hexdocs.pm/Astarte.Core.Mapping.md): This module handles Interface Mappings using Ecto Changesets

- [Astarte.Core.Mapping.DatabaseRetentionPolicy](https://astarte-core.hexdocs.pm/Astarte.Core.Mapping.DatabaseRetentionPolicy.md)
- [Astarte.Core.Mapping.EndpointsAutomaton](https://astarte-core.hexdocs.pm/Astarte.Core.Mapping.EndpointsAutomaton.md)

- [Astarte.Core.Mapping.ValueType](https://astarte-core.hexdocs.pm/Astarte.Core.Mapping.ValueType.md)
- [Astarte.Core.Realm](https://astarte-core.hexdocs.pm/Astarte.Core.Realm.md): Functions that deal with Astarte realms

- [Astarte.Core.StorageType](https://astarte-core.hexdocs.pm/Astarte.Core.StorageType.md)
- [Astarte.Core.Triggers.DataTrigger](https://astarte-core.hexdocs.pm/Astarte.Core.Triggers.DataTrigger.md)

- [Astarte.Core.Triggers.SimpleTriggerConfig](https://astarte-core.hexdocs.pm/Astarte.Core.Triggers.SimpleTriggerConfig.md): This module handles the functions for creating a `SimpleTriggerConfig` and converting it to and from a `TaggedSimpleTrigger`.
